display_long_description:
The XR-based Firefighting Facility Inspection and Operation Simulation System is educational content designed to teach the inspection and operation methods of firefighting facilities.
In environments where training is difficult due to time and space constraints, users can experience inspection and operation procedures in a virtual environment using Quest Pro and Quest 3, allowing them to learn correct usage methods.

This content enables hands-on experience with the following components of the XR-based Firefighting Facility Inspection and Operation Simulation System:
K-class fire extinguishers, wet sprinkler systems, vestibule smoke control systems, and indoor fire hydrants.

Users learn the operating principles of K-class fire extinguishers, wet sprinkler systems, vestibule smoke control systems, and indoor fire hydrants, and then proceed with practical training. Afterward, an evaluation of the training is conducted.

This content can only be operated in Quest Pro and Quest 3 environments.

This content is a version of the XR-based Firefighting Facility Inspection and Operation Simulation System that provides K-class fire extinguishers, wet sprinkler systems, vestibule smoke control systems, and indoor fire hydrants.
